name: Azure Gourd
description: Lu You's poem "Taoist Liu Presents a Small Gourd" says: "Although the gourd is small, it hides in the world, but it stays with me for thousands of miles." The gourd is homophonic to "Fu Lu". Pinku draws on the beautiful meaning of fortune and integrates elements of nature, hoping that Xiaoyaoyou will carry people's pursuit of a happy life and accompany them across thousands of miles of mountains, rivers and clouds.
